# Data Prep

## HPS data (NP sample)

```{r}
# HPS microdata (Wave 61)
hps <- read_csv("./microdata_hps2023.csv") %>%
  filter(WEEK == 61) %>%
  mutate(# binary sex
         male = (EGENID_BIRTH == 1),
         # education level, collapsed
         educ_lths = (EEDUC %in% c(1,2)),     # less than HS(1)/some HS(2)
         educ_hs = (EEDUC== 3),               # HS grad(3)
         educ_somecoll = (EEDUC %in% c(4,5)), # some college(4)/associates degree(5)
         educ_bach = (EEDUC == 6),            # bachelor's degree(6)
         educ_graddeg = (EEDUC == 7),         # graduate degree(7)
         # race/ethnicity
         race_hisp = (RHISPANIC == 2),                   # Hispanic
         race_nhwhite = (RHISPANIC == 1 & RRACE == 1),   # NH white
         race_nhblack = (RHISPANIC == 1 & RRACE == 2),   # NH Black
         race_nhasian = (RHISPANIC == 1 & RRACE == 3),   # NH Asian
         race_other = (RHISPANIC == 1 & RRACE == 4),     # any other race alone or in combination
         # age, categorized
         age = 2023 - TBIRTH_YEAR,
         age_18_25 = (18 <= age & age <= 25),
         age_26_35 = (26 <= age & age <= 35),
         age_36_45 = (36 <= age & age <= 45),
         age_46_55 = (46 <= age & age <= 55),
         age_56_65 = (46 <= age & age <= 65),
         age_66_75 = (66 <= age & age <= 75),
         age_76plus = (age >= 76),
         # region
         region_ne = (REGION == 1), # northeast
         region_s = (REGION == 2),  # south
         region_mw = (REGION == 3), # midwest
         region_w = (REGION == 4),  # west
         # remove missing codes from PHQ and GAD variables
         across(c(ANXIOUS,WORRY, INTEREST, DOWN), ~ na_if(.x, -99)),
         # Depression score (PHQ-2)
         phq2 = INTEREST + DOWN - 2, #-2 necessary since vars are 1-4 but scoring uses 0-3
         # Anxiety score (GAD)
         gad2 = ANXIOUS + WORRY - 2, #-2 necessary since vars are 1-4 but scoring uses 0-3
         )
```

HPS sample size: `r nrow(hps)`

## NHIS data (P sample)

```{r}
# NHIS 2023 microdata
nhis <- read_csv("./microdata_nhis2023.csv") %>%
  mutate(# binary sex
         male = case_when(SEX_A == 1 ~ 1,
                          SEX_A == 2 ~ 0), # 7(REF) and 9(DK) will be coded as missing
         # education level, collapsed
         educ = case_when(EDUCP_A %in% c(97,99) ~ NA, .default = EDUCP_A),
         educ_lths = case_when(!is.na(educ) ~ 1*(educ %in% c(1,2))),       # grade 1-11(1)/12th no diploma(2)
         educ_hs = case_when(!is.na(educ) ~ 1*(educ %in% c(3,4))),         # GED(3)/HS grad(4)
         educ_somecoll = case_when(!is.na(educ) ~ 1*(educ %in% c(5,6,7))), # some college(5)/associates degree(6,7)
         educ_bach = case_when(!is.na(educ) ~ 1*(educ == 8)),              # bachelor's degree(6)
         educ_graddeg = case_when(!is.na(educ) ~ 1*(educ %in% c(9,10))),   # graduate degree(7)
         # race/ethnicity
         race_hisp = 1*(HISPALLP_A == 1),            # Hispanic
         race_nhwhite = 1*(HISPALLP_A == 2),         # NH white alone
         race_nhblack = 1*(HISPALLP_A == 3),         # NH Black alone
         race_nhasian = 1*(HISPALLP_A == 4),         # NH Asian alone
         race_other = 1*(HISPALLP_A %in% c(5,6,7)),  # any other race alone or in combination
         # age, categorized
         age = case_when(AGEP_A %in% c(97,99) ~ NA, .default = AGEP_A),
         age_18_25 = case_when(!is.na(age) ~ 1*(18 <= age & age <= 25)),
         age_26_35 = case_when(!is.na(age) ~ 1*(26 <= age & age <= 35)),
         age_36_45 = case_when(!is.na(age) ~ 1*(36 <= age & age <= 45)),
         age_46_55 = case_when(!is.na(age) ~ 1*(46 <= age & age <= 55)),
         age_56_65 = case_when(!is.na(age) ~ 1*(56 <= age & age <= 65)),
         age_66_75 = case_when(!is.na(age) ~ 1*(66 <= age & age <= 75)),
         age_76plus = case_when(!is.na(age) ~ 1*(age >= 76)),
         # region
         region_ne = 1*(REGION == 1), # northeast
         region_s = 1*(REGION == 3),  # south
         region_mw = 1*(REGION == 2), # midwest
         region_w = 1*(REGION == 4),  # west
         # remove missing codes from PHQ and GAD variables
         across(c(PHQ43_A, PHQ44_A, PHQ41_A, PHQ42_A), ~ na_if(.x, 7)),
         across(c(PHQ43_A, PHQ44_A, PHQ41_A, PHQ42_A), ~ na_if(.x, 8)),
         across(c(PHQ43_A, PHQ44_A, PHQ41_A, PHQ42_A), ~ na_if(.x, 9)),
         # Depression score (PHQ-2)
         phq2 = PHQ41_A + PHQ42_A - 2, #-2 necessary since vars are 1-4 but scoring uses 0-3
         # Anxiety score (GAD)
         gad2 = PHQ43_A + PHQ44_A - 2, #-2 necessary since vars are 1-4 but scoring uses 0-3
         )
# indicator for complete data on proxy variable (gad2) and covariates
nhis$ccindZA <- nhis %>%
  dplyr::select(male:region_w, gad2) %>%
  complete.cases()
# indicator for complete data on covariates
nhis$ccindZ <- nhis %>%
  dplyr::select(male:region_w) %>%
  complete.cases()

```

NHIS full sample size: `r nrow(nhis)`

NHIS sample size with complete data for covariates (Z):  `r sum(nhis$ccindZ)`

NHIS sample size with complete data for proxy variable (A) and covariates (Z):  `r sum(nhis$ccindZA)`

# Summary of Variables Used

* Y = depression score (PHQ-2)  
* A = anxiety score (GAD-2)  
* Z = sex (binary), education (5 level), race/ethnicity (5 level), age (7 level), region (4 level)

## HPS (NP sample)

```{r}
hps %>%
  dplyr::select(phq2, gad2, male, starts_with("educ_"), starts_with("race_"), starts_with("age_"), starts_with("region_")) %>%
  gtsummary::tbl_summary(type = c(phq2, gad2) ~ "continuous2",
                         statistic = c(phq2, gad2) ~ c("{mean} ({sd})", "{min}, {max}"),
                         missing_text = "Missing")
```

## NHIS (P sample)

```{r}
nhis.design <- survey::svydesign(~PPSU, weights = ~WTFA_A, strata = ~PSTRAT, data = nhis, nest = TRUE)
nhis.design %>%
  gtsummary::tbl_svysummary(include = c(phq2, gad2, 
                                        male,
                                        educ_lths, educ_hs, educ_somecoll, educ_bach, educ_graddeg,
                                        race_hisp, race_nhwhite, race_nhblack, race_nhasian, race_other,
                                        age_18_25, age_26_35, age_36_45, age_46_55, age_56_65, age_66_75, age_76plus,
                                        region_ne, region_s, region_mw, region_w),
                            type = c(phq2, gad2) ~ "continuous2",
                            statistic = list(c(phq2, gad2) ~ c("{mean} ({sd})", "{min}, {max}")),
                            missing = "no")
```

# Estimators

## Naive Estimate from NP sample

Unweighted mean

```{r}
est_naive <- mean(hps$phq2, na.rm=TRUE)
fit <- lm(phq2 ~ 1, data=hps)
lb_naive <- confint(fit)[1]
ub_naive <- confint(fit)[2]
est_naive
c(lb_naive, ub_naive)
```

Weighted (using HPS weights) mean

```{r}
hps.design <- survey::svydesign(~1, weights = ~PWEIGHT, data = hps)
est_hpswt <- svymean(~phq2, hps.design, na.rm = TRUE)[1]
ci <- confint(svymean(~phq2, hps.design, na.rm = TRUE))
lb_hpswt <- ci[1]
ub_hpswt <- ci[2]
est_hpswt
c(lb_hpswt, ub_hpswt)
```

## Proposed Approach

```{r}
# NP sample
# subset to complete cases
samp.NP <- hps %>%
  dplyr::select(phq2, # Y VARIABLE
                male,
                educ_lths, educ_hs, educ_somecoll, educ_bach, # REF = educ_graddeg,
                race_hisp, race_nhwhite, race_nhblack, race_nhasian, # REF = race_other,
                age_18_25, age_26_35, age_36_45, age_46_55, age_56_65, age_66_75, # REF = age_76plus,
                region_ne, region_s, region_mw, # REF = region_w
                gad2) %>%  #A VARIABLE
  drop_na()
# summary stats
stats_NP <- list(n_s = nrow(samp.NP),
                 mean_YZA_s = colMeans(samp.NP),
                 var_YZA_s = var(samp.NP))
```

HPS sample size: n = `r nrow(hps)`

After excluding missing Y, Z, or A values: n = `r nrow(samp.NP)`


```{r}
# P sample
# summary stats - using all available cases -- not just complete cases
mean_P <- c(svymean(~ male, nhis.design, na.rm=TRUE)[1],
            svymean(~ educ_lths, nhis.design, na.rm=TRUE)[1],
            svymean(~ educ_hs, nhis.design, na.rm=TRUE)[1],
            svymean(~ educ_somecoll, nhis.design, na.rm=TRUE)[1],
            svymean(~ educ_bach, nhis.design, na.rm=TRUE)[1], # REF = educ_graddeg,
            svymean(~ race_hisp, nhis.design, na.rm=TRUE)[1],
            svymean(~ race_nhwhite, nhis.design, na.rm=TRUE)[1],
            svymean(~ race_nhblack, nhis.design, na.rm=TRUE)[1],
            svymean(~ race_nhasian, nhis.design, na.rm=TRUE)[1],# REF = race_other,
            svymean(~ age_18_25, nhis.design, na.rm=TRUE)[1],
            svymean(~ age_26_35, nhis.design, na.rm=TRUE)[1],
            svymean(~ age_36_45, nhis.design, na.rm=TRUE)[1],
            svymean(~ age_46_55, nhis.design, na.rm=TRUE)[1],
            svymean(~ age_56_65, nhis.design, na.rm=TRUE)[1],
            svymean(~ age_66_75, nhis.design, na.rm=TRUE)[1],# REF = age_76plus,
            svymean(~ region_ne, nhis.design, na.rm=TRUE)[1],
            svymean(~ region_s, nhis.design, na.rm=TRUE)[1],
            svymean(~ region_mw, nhis.design, na.rm=TRUE)[1], # REF = region_w
            svymean(~ gad2, nhis.design, na.rm=TRUE)[1]) # A variable
var_P <- as.matrix(svyvar(~ male + educ_lths + educ_hs + educ_somecoll + educ_bach +
                            race_hisp + race_nhwhite + race_nhblack + race_nhasian +
                            age_18_25 + age_26_35 + age_36_45 + age_46_55 + age_56_65 + age_66_75 +
                            region_ne + region_s + region_mw + 
                            gad2, 
                          na.rm=TRUE, design=nhis.design))[1:length(mean_P), 1:length(mean_P)]
# back out the selected estimates (from NP sample) to get nonselected estimates
xbar <- mean_P
s2 <- var_P
xbar_s <- stats_NP$mean_YZA_s[-1]
s2_s <- stats_NP$var_YZA_s[-1,-1]
N <- sum(nhis$WTFA_A) # pop size
n_s <- stats_NP$n_s   # selected sample (NP) size
sfrac <- n_s/N
n_ns <- N - n_s
# back out the means
xbar_ns <- (xbar - sfrac*xbar_s) / (1-sfrac)
# back out the variance matrix
s2_ns <- ((n_s + n_ns - 1) * s2 - (n_s - 1) * s2_s - n_s * xbar_s %*% t(xbar_s) - n_ns * xbar_ns %*% t(xbar_ns) + (n_s + n_ns) * xbar %*% t(xbar))/(n_ns-1)
# backed out NS sample stats
stats_NS <- list(n_ns = n_ns,
                 mean_ZA_ns = xbar_ns,
                 var_ZA_ns = s2_ns)

# Z variables for P sample, adding column of 1s for intercept
# Some observations have missing covariate (Z) values, remove them
nhis_ccZ <- nhis %>%
  filter(ccindZ) %>%
  dplyr::select(WTFA_A, PPSU, PSTRAT,
                male,
                educ_lths, educ_hs, educ_somecoll, educ_bach,
                race_hisp, race_nhwhite, race_nhblack, race_nhasian,
                age_18_25, age_26_35, age_36_45, age_46_55, age_56_65, age_66_75,
                region_ne, region_s, region_mw)
# Z matrix for complete cases
ZMAT_P <- nhis_ccZ %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(WTFA_A, PPSU, PSTRAT)) %>%
  add_column(intercept = 1) %>%
  relocate(intercept) %>%
  as.matrix()
# number of CC
n_P_CC <- nrow(nhis_ccZ)
```

NHIS sample size with complete Z variables (i.e., sample we impute to): `r nrow(nhis_ccZ)`

```{r}
## Uniform(0,1) prior on phi
set.seed(347834)
NIMPS <- 100
draws <- mub_reg_bayes(stats_NP, stats_NS, zparams = 18, ndraws = NIMPS)
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
# Look at MUB(phi) posterior distributions - based on only 100 draws
theme_set(theme_bw())
mub <- as_tibble(draws$mubdraws) %>%
  pivot_longer(index.B0:index.B18, names_to = "parameter", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarize(mub = median(value),
            lb = quantile(value, .025),
            ub = quantile(value, .975)) %>%
  mutate(parameter_f = factor(parameter,
                              levels = names(draws$mubdraws),
                              labels = c("intercept", names(samp.NP)[2:19])))
mub %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mub, y = fct_rev(parameter_f))) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lb, xmax = ub)) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) + 
  labs(y = "Z Variable",
       x = "95% Credible Interval for MUB(phi)")
```

Proxy strength

```{r}
median(draws$rhodraws)
```

Bayesian weighted logistic regression for S|Z

Using probability sample (with corresponding design weights) and non-probability sample with weights = 1

```{r}
# stack NP and P datasets
stacked <- bind_rows(samp.NP, nhis_ccZ) %>%
  # indicator for which sample (1 = NP, 0 = P)
  mutate(S = case_when(is.na(WTFA_A) ~ 1, 
                       .default = 0)) %>%
  # assign weight = 1 for NP sample units
  mutate(WTFA_A = case_when(S == 1 ~ 1, .default = WTFA_A))

# Run Bayes weighted logistic regression using rstan
bayesmodel_s <- stan_glm(
  S ~ male + 
    educ_lths + educ_hs + educ_somecoll + educ_bach + 
    race_hisp + race_nhwhite + race_nhblack + race_nhasian +
    age_18_25 + age_26_35 + age_36_45 + age_46_55 + age_56_65 + age_66_75 +
    region_ne + region_s + region_mw,
  data = stacked,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  weights = WTFA_A,
  seed = 99283,
  chains = 1,
  warmup = 1000,
  iter = 1500, # 500 draws after warm-up, # will discard the first half of the chain
  cores = parallel::detectCores()-1)
# check summary
# summary(bayesmodel_s)
# check trace plots
plot(bayesmodel_s, plotfun = "trace")

# posterior draws of logistic regression coefficients
draws_betas_s_model <- as.matrix(bayesmodel_s)
# apply(draws_betas_s_model, 2, function(x) quantile(x, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975)))
# thin the chain for use in imputation to only 100 draws
draws_betas_s_model <- draws_betas_s_model[seq(5,500,5),]
```

Transform into draws of the propensities

```{r}
# Get draws of propensities P(S=1|Z)
xb <- ZMAT_P %*% t(draws_betas_s_model)  # rows = observations, columns = draws
DRAWS_prob_s <- 1 - 1/(1 + exp(xb))
# check max probability is <0.5 so can use the bias correction
max(DRAWS_prob_s)
# bias correction of https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8526388/
DRAWS_prob_s <- DRAWS_prob_s/(1-DRAWS_prob_s)
```

Draws of S|Z for probability sample

```{r}
# Draws of S|Z (for probability sample only)
n_P <- nrow(ZMAT_P)
set.seed(17374)
S_vec <- rbinom(n = n_P * NIMPS, size = 1, prob = as.vector(DRAWS_prob_s))
DRAWS_S <- matrix(S_vec, nrow = n_P, ncol = NIMPS)
# check to see how often each unit's draw will come from S=1
table(apply(DRAWS_S, 1, sum))
# 28624 units are always draws from S=0, never from S=1 (0 of 100 imputations from S=1)
# 682 units have 1 of 100 imputations from S=1
# 13 units have 2 of 100 imputations from S=1
```

Draws from Y|Z based on mixture of and Y|Z,S=0 and Y|Z,S=1

```{r}
set.seed(33455)
# Draws of Y|Z,S=1 in P sample
DRAW_y_s1 <- ZMAT_P %*% t(draws$betadraws_s) + apply(as.matrix(draws$residdraws_s), 1, function(x) rnorm(n_P, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(x)))
# Draws of Y|Z,S=0 in P sample
DRAW_y_s0 <- ZMAT_P %*% t(draws$betadraws_ns) + apply(as.matrix(draws$residdraws_ns), 1, function(x) rnorm(n_P, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(x)))
# Combine to get draws of Y|Z (mixture distribution)
DRAW_y <- DRAW_y_s1*DRAWS_S + DRAW_y_s0*(1-DRAWS_S)

# Use svymean to get design-based estimates of mean of y in each of the NDRAWS imputed datasets
dat_imputed <- DRAW_y %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  bind_cols(nhis_ccZ)
# each of the imputed Y variables will be called "V1", "V2", etc
nhis_ccZ.design <- survey::svydesign(~PPSU, weights = ~WTFA_A, strata = ~PSTRAT, 
                                     data = dat_imputed, 
                                     nest = TRUE)
# estimate weighted mean and variance
svyest <- svymean(reformulate(names(dat_imputed)[1:NIMPS]), nhis_ccZ.design)
theta <- coef(svyest)
var_within <- diag(vcov(svyest))
# combine with Rubin's Rules
est <- mice::pool.scalar(Q = theta, U = var_within, n = n_P)
est_ppmmreg <- est$qbar
var_ppmmreg <- est$t
se_ppmmreg <- sqrt(var_ppmmreg)
tstar <- qt(0.975, est$df)
lb_ppmmreg <- est_ppmmreg - tstar*se_ppmmreg
ub_ppmmreg <- est_ppmmreg + tstar*se_ppmmreg
est_ppmmreg
c(lb_ppmmreg, ub_ppmmreg)
# # Compare to posterior distribution of the point estimates
# median(theta)
# quantile(theta, c(0.025, 0.975))
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
# Plot imputed estimates versus phi
plot(draws$phidraws, theta)
```

## Proposed Approach with $\phi$ = 1

```{r}
## phi = 1
set.seed(347834)
draws_phi1 <- mub_reg_bayes(stats_NP, stats_NS, zparams = 18, ndraws = NIMPS, userphi = 1)

# Draws of Y|Z,S=1 in P sample
DRAW_y_s1 <- ZMAT_P %*% t(draws_phi1$betadraws_s) + apply(as.matrix(draws_phi1$residdraws_s), 1, function(x) rnorm(n_P, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(x)))
# Draws of Y|Z,S=0 in P sample
DRAW_y_s0 <- ZMAT_P %*% t(draws_phi1$betadraws_ns) + apply(as.matrix(draws_phi1$residdraws_ns), 1, function(x) rnorm(n_P, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(x)))
# Combine to get draws of Y|Z (mixture distribution)
DRAW_y <- DRAW_y_s1*DRAWS_S + DRAW_y_s0*(1-DRAWS_S)

# Use svymean to get design-based estimates of mean of y in each of the NDRAWS imputed datasets
dat_imputed <- DRAW_y %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  bind_cols(nhis_ccZ)
# each of the imputed Y variables will be called "V1", "V2", etc
nhis_ccZ.design <- survey::svydesign(~PPSU, weights = ~WTFA_A, strata = ~PSTRAT, 
                                     data = dat_imputed, 
                                     nest = TRUE)
# estimate weighted mean and variance
svyest <- svymean(reformulate(names(dat_imputed)[1:NIMPS]), nhis_ccZ.design)
theta <- coef(svyest)
var_within <- diag(vcov(svyest))
# combine with Rubin's Rules
est <- mice::pool.scalar(Q = theta, U = var_within, n = n_P)
est_ppmmreg.phi1 <- est$qbar
var_ppmmreg.phi1 <- est$t
se_ppmmreg.phi1 <- sqrt(var_ppmmreg.phi1)
tstar <- qt(0.975, est$df)
lb_ppmmreg.phi1 <- est_ppmmreg.phi1 - tstar*se_ppmmreg.phi1
ub_ppmmreg.phi1 <- est_ppmmreg.phi1 + tstar*se_ppmmreg.phi1
est_ppmmreg.phi1
c(lb_ppmmreg.phi1, ub_ppmmreg.phi1)
```

## Mass Imputation (assuming transportability)

```{r}
# Mass imputation
chen_mi <- nonprobsvy::nonprob(outcome = phq2 ~ male + educ_lths + educ_hs + educ_somecoll + educ_bach +
                                 race_hisp + race_nhwhite + race_nhblack + race_nhasian +
                                 age_18_25 + age_26_35 + age_36_45 + age_46_55 + age_56_65 + age_66_75 +
                                 region_ne + region_s + region_mw +
                                 gad2, 
                               data = samp.NP, 
                               svydesign = subset(nhis.design, ccindZA==TRUE), 
                               method_outcome = "glm", 
                               family_outcome = "gaussian")
est_mi <- as.numeric(chen_mi$output[1])
lb_mi <- as.numeric(chen_mi$confidence_interval[1])
ub_mi <- as.numeric(chen_mi$confidence_interval[2])
est_mi
c(lb_mi, ub_mi)
```

## IPW (assuming ignorable selection)

```{r}
# IPW
chen_ipw <- nonprobsvy::nonprob(selection = ~ male + educ_lths + educ_hs + educ_somecoll + educ_bach +
                                 race_hisp + race_nhwhite + race_nhblack + race_nhasian +
                                 age_18_25 + age_26_35 + age_36_45 + age_46_55 + age_56_65 + age_66_75 +
                                 region_ne + region_s + region_mw +
                                 gad2, 
                                target = ~ phq2, 
                                data = samp.NP, 
                                svydesign = subset(nhis.design, ccindZA==TRUE),
                                control_selection = control_sel(maxit = 1000, est_method = "gee"))
est_ipw <- as.numeric(chen_ipw$output[1])
lb_ipw <- as.numeric(chen_ipw$confidence_interval[1])
ub_ipw <- as.numeric(chen_ipw$confidence_interval[2])
est_ipw
c(lb_ipw, ub_ipw)
```

## DR (assuming transportability/ignorable selection)

```{r}
# Doubly robust (assumes transportability)
chen_dr <- nonprobsvy::nonprob(selection = ~ male + educ_lths + educ_hs + educ_somecoll + educ_bach +
                                 race_hisp + race_nhwhite + race_nhblack + race_nhasian +
                                 age_18_25 + age_26_35 + age_36_45 + age_46_55 + age_56_65 + age_66_75 +
                                 region_ne + region_s + region_mw +
                                 gad2, 
                               outcome = phq2 ~ male + educ_lths + educ_hs + educ_somecoll + educ_bach +
                                 race_hisp + race_nhwhite + race_nhblack + race_nhasian +
                                 age_18_25 + age_26_35 + age_36_45 + age_46_55 + age_56_65 + age_66_75 +
                                 region_ne + region_s + region_mw +
                                 gad2, 
                               data = samp.NP, 
                               svydesign = subset(nhis.design, ccindZA==TRUE), 
                               method_outcome = "glm", 
                               family_outcome = "gaussian",
                               control_selection = control_sel(maxit = 1000, est_method = "gee"))
est_dr <- as.numeric(chen_dr$output[1])
lb_dr <- as.numeric(chen_dr$confidence_interval[1])
ub_dr <- as.numeric(chen_dr$confidence_interval[2])
est_dr
c(lb_dr, ub_dr)
```

## Direct application of PPMM

```{r}
# NP sample summary stats - use same data just rename the list objects
stats_NP2 <- list(mean_YZ = stats_NP$mean_YZA_s,
                  var_YZ = stats_NP$var_YZA_s,
                  n_YZ = stats_NP$n_s)
# Non-selected sample summary stats - use same data just rename the list objects
stats_NS2 <- list(mean_Z = stats_NS$mean_ZA_ns,
                  var_Z = stats_NS$var_ZA_ns,
                  n_Z = stats_NS$n_ns)

# Apply fully Bayesian approach
set.seed(2282)
ppmm_bayes <- ppmm::means_bayes(stats_NP2,
                                stats_NS2,
                                phi_character = "runif(1)",
                                ndraws = 1000)
# Plot versus phi
plot(ppmm_bayes$phi, ppmm_bayes$muY)
# posterior median and 95% CrI
est_ppmm <- median(ppmm_bayes$muY)
# credible interval
lb_ppmm <- as.numeric(quantile(ppmm_bayes$muY, 0.025))
ub_ppmm <- as.numeric(quantile(ppmm_bayes$muY, 0.975))

est_ppmm
c(lb_ppmm, ub_ppmm)
```

## True mean based on NHIS 

```{r}
nhiswt <- svymean(~phq2, design = nhis.design, na.rm = TRUE)
est_nhiswt <- coef(nhiswt)
ci <- confint(nhiswt)
lb_nhiswt <- ci[1]
ub_nhiswt <- ci[2]
est_nhiswt
c(lb_nhiswt, ub_nhiswt)
```

## Summary table

```{r}
allmethods <- tibble(est_nhiswt, lb_nhiswt, ub_nhiswt,
                     est_naive, lb_naive, ub_naive,
                     est_hpswt, lb_hpswt, ub_hpswt,
                     est_ppmmreg, lb_ppmmreg, ub_ppmmreg,
                     est_ppmmreg.phi1, lb_ppmmreg.phi1, ub_ppmmreg.phi1,
                     est_mi, lb_mi, ub_mi,
                     est_ipw, lb_ipw, ub_ipw,
                     est_dr, lb_dr, ub_dr,
                     est_ppmm, lb_ppmm, ub_ppmm) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = c(".value", "method"), names_sep="_" ) %>%
  mutate(method_f = factor(method,
                           levels = c("nhiswt", "naive", "hpswt", "mi", "ipw", "dr", 
                                      "ppmm", "ppmmreg", "ppmmreg.phi1")))
allmethods %>%
  arrange(method_f) %>%
  dplyr::select(-method_f) %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(digits = 3) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_classic("striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r}
allmethods %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = est, y = fct_rev(method_f))) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lb, xmax = ub), width = 0.2) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1.5)) + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = est_nhiswt), linetype = 2) + 
  labs(x = "Estimate and 95% Interval", y = " ")
```
